title: Partner/state gating gives a conditional cross-coupling bound and an unacquired reactor proposal
status_authority: Exact receipt-selected XH1 source bytes and capture receipt are preserved. This status records the source-reported conditional model and proposals; integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, or advantage.
reported_status: The XH1 report derives a selectivity bound for freely mixing radicals under stipulated elementary mass-action kinetics and proposes molecular partner/state gating. Its feed-schedule, confinement, orthogonal-gate, occupancy, energy and throughput examples are synthetic or assumed. No code/data attachment, physical reactor, acquired rate, matched experiment, external prior-art review, or practical advantage is supplied.
scientific_scope_status: For r_AB=k_AB ab and r_AA=(1/2)k_AA a^2, r_BB=(1/2)k_BB b^2 under the report’s same-local-kinetics-throughout premise, the source derives S_AB <= k_AB/(k_AB+sqrt(k_AA k_BB)); equal coefficients give 50%, and 99% by kinetic discrimination alone requires k_AB >= 99 sqrt(k_AA k_BB). This is not a universal synthesis limit. The reusable compartment and orthogonal reaction-state-gating examples are conceptual/synthetic, not measured. The reported isotope-crossover test remains proposed. Correctness, priority, physical feasibility and advantage remain UNKNOWN.
